items.title: Slide Hampton interviewed by Monk Rowe, West Orange, New Jersey, July 30, 2003
items.q: Who was the lead singer? Otis?

ctx.x: They said, “Sure we can.” And they went in for an hour or so and worked on some stuff and came back out and said okay this is it. And they sang some stuff like the Four Freshmen. And then they made a whole CD together with those guys singing behind him. They were like that. They were guys that really loved to work together They had had a great experience together, good and bad. And I conducted for them and did some writing for them and I really liked those guys.
Who was the lead singer? Otis?
